get.description:
This Brain's X25519 receiving key, for a sender to seal a bundle to.

Public by construction — a public key encrypts, it does not decrypt —
so handing it out is the whole point. Still admin-gated and still
behind the share flag, because minting the key is a decision to
participate in sharing at all.

post.description:
Mark one memory as never-leaving (or clear the mark).

The cloud filter has always looked for this flag. Until 10.2.0 nothing
in the product could set it, so the guard could not fire. Ingestion
stamps secret-bearing paths automatically; this covers what a path
cannot tell you — a note whose *content* is private.
